highlights: Sorting Inventory by "Newest first" no longer leads with the packets that have no purchase date at all. Anything unrecorded now sorts last whichever way you sort, on every column
Add seeds goes straight to the form with consumable and seeds already filled in. It was a chooser with one option, which just made you tap twice to get where you were already going
When you store a saved-seed lot, the app records the year it was saved — the number that decides whether the seed is still worth sowing in three years. It never overwrites a year you entered yourself
